task: submit a connector to the directory

families.label: File the connector through an Anthropic submission form on the web

variants.label: Remote MCP servers (including MCP Apps): multi-step submission portal in organization settings on Claude.ai
preconditions: a Team or Enterprise organization (the portal is part of organization settings)
directory management access: Owner or Primary owner, or on Enterprise a custom role carrying the Directory or Libraries permission
documentation URL, privacy policy URL, icon, support contact, and test account credentials ready
3-5 carousel screenshots if submitting an MCP App
the server is remote and served over https:// (the portal accepts remote MCP servers only)
steps: Open the submission portal at claude.ai/admin-settings/directory/submissions/new in your organization's settings
Read the Introduction step on what a directory listing does and does not do
In Connection, confirm the https:// server URL, the transport (streamable HTTP or SSE), and whether users reach the server by Universal URL, Multiple URLs, or a URL pattern
In Tools, let tools, prompts, and resources sync, and fix on your server any tools flagged for missing titles or annotations
In Listing, enter server name, tagline, description, one to five categories, documentation and privacy policy URLs, support contact, icon, and the permanent URL slug
In Use cases, describe the primary use cases, what users need before connecting, and whether the connector reads, writes, or both
In Company, give company name and website plus a primary contact for review updates
In Authentication, choose OAuth, a custom connection, or no authentication, within the limits the Connection choice imposes
In Data handling, state whether the API is your own, proxied with permission, or a third party's, and whether health data or sponsored content is involved
In Test & launch, give reviewer test-account setup and access instructions and confirm you ran every tool via MCP Inspector or as a custom connector in Claude
In Compliance, give all seven policy acknowledgments
Read through the Review step, note any quality warnings, and submit

sources.anchor: ### What to expect in the portal

variants.notes: Progress saves automatically in the browser between steps. Submitting accepts the directory terms and the maintenance commitments; the seven Compliance acknowledgments are the explicit gate. Status then appears in the submissions dashboard (T-059).

variants.label: Desktop extensions (MCPB): separate submission form, no portal or organization access
preconditions: the local MCP server is packaged as an MCP Bundle (.mcpb)
privacy policy section in README.md, a privacy_policies array in manifest.json (manifest_version 0.2+), and HTTPS privacy policy URLs
no portal or organization access required
steps: Open the desktop extension submission form at clau.de/desktop-extention-submission
File the desktop extension through that form
variants.notes: The source names Claude Desktop as the client; that client is part of product `claude`. Same surface and mechanism as P1a, but a different destination and no organization/role precondition, so a reader following P1a would not succeed here.

claude.note: The only product documenting directory submission. Route depends on connector type: remote servers and MCP Apps go through the org-settings portal, MCPB desktop extensions through a standalone form.

checked: connectors--building--submission ### What to expect in the portal
summary: One web-portal click-through family on `claude`: org-settings portal for remote servers and MCP Apps, separate form for MCPB desktop extensions.
open_questions: The MCPB form's own steps and how directory terms are accepted there are not documented in the corpus; only the entry link is given, so P1b's outcome rests on the routing sentence.
Whether MCPB submission is genuinely client-specific (Claude Desktop) rather than product-wide cannot be settled from this unit alone, now that claude.ai and Claude Desktop are one product.
Plugin submission (/docs/plugins/submit) is referenced as the route for skills but lies outside this unit; not checked here.
